spec_raw: Badge is not aligned with the UX prototype

spec_refined.title: Badge: align sizing and placement with the UX prototype
spec_refined.description: Badge rendering deviates from the UX prototype: vertical centering inside tab labels is off, counter badges are not sized per the sizing scale, and spacing between badge and adjacent text is inconsistent across sizes.
acceptance_criteria: Badge is vertically centered relative to adjacent label text in all three sizes
Counter badge respects the component sizing scale (sm/md/lg) for height and min-width
Badge-to-text gap is consistent across sizes and matches the spacing token
Badge inside modus-wc-tabs custom content renders without clipping
All existing badge and tabs tests pass
spec_refined.technical_notes: Touches badge tailwind classes and the tabs story that embeds badges (see issue #1242 for the tab case).
